product.description: Detectivul Pierre rezolvă un caz extraordinar! Domnul X a furat din muzeu Piatra labirintului, care are puterea de a transforma intregul oraș intr-un imens labirint. Ajută-i pe Pierre și pe Carmen, prietena lui, să parcurgă toate labirinturile și să-l oprească pe domnul X inainte de a fi prea tacirc;rziu! Pentru a salva situația va trebui să găsești drumul spre ieșire in cele 15 labirinturi complicate, să depistezi o seamă de indicii ascunse și să rezolvi toate celelalte provocări din această carte cu ilustrații fascinante! Vei avea parte de o călătorie intr-o lume fantastică, plină de subterane, de baloane cu aer cald și de castele bacirc;ntuite. Ieșirile din labirinturi și soluțiile celorlalte activități se află pe ultima pagină a cărții. Toți detectivii de labirinturi cu vacirc;rsta de peste 7 ani vor fi incacirc;ntați să-și petreacă timpul liber alături de Pierre. Singuri, impreună cu părinții sau cu prietenii, vor avea ce face ore intregi! Nici nu-și vor da seama cum trece timpul, iar distracția este garantată! # Pierre the Detective in the Labyrinth: A Fantastic Adventure

Dive into an extraordinary world with *Pierre, Detective in the Labyrinth* by Litera! This captivating book invites young readers and parents on a thrilling quest where detective Pierre must solve a mystery involving the legendary Labyrinth of Stone. Get ready for an adventure filled with fascinating illustrations, puzzles, and endless imagination!

## Unravel the Mystery of the Labyrinth

Detective Pierre faces an incredible challenge: the famous Labyrinth of Stone has been stolen, threatening to transform the entire city into an immense maze! Join Pierre and his friend Carmen as they journey through all 15 complicated labyrinths. Their mission is to find the way out and stop the villain, Mr. X, before itâs too late!

## A World of Wonder and Discovery

This book is more than just a story; it's an interactive experience designed for discovery. As Pierre navigates the maze, readers will uncover hidden clues and solve various challenges. The adventure takes them to a fantastic realm filled with underground tunnels, hot air balloons, and ancient castles. Discover the solutions to the labyrinth exits and other exciting activities on the very last page of the book!

## Perfect for Family Fun

Whether you are reading alone or with family, this book offers hours of engaging entertainment. The captivating illustrations bring the fantastical setting to life, making it an ideal activity for children and parents alike. Itâs the perfect way to spark curiosity and encourage problem-solving skills in a magical world.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**What is this book about?**
It is an adventure story where Detective Pierre and his friend Carmen must navigate 15 complex labyrinths to recover a stolen artifact and stop a villain.

**Who is the target audience for this book?**
This book is designed for children and parents, offering engaging activities and stories perfect for family reading time.

**Where can I find the solutions?**
The solutions for exiting the labyrinths and other activities are conveniently located on the last page of the book.
